rows.title: Ayatul Kursi
rows.t: ayatul kursi allah there is no deity except him the ever living the sustainer of all existence neither drowsiness overtakes him nor sleep to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth who is it that can intercede with him except by his permission he knows what is presently before them and what will be after them and they encompass not a thing of his knowledge except for what he wills his kursi extends over the heavens and the earth and their preservation tires him not and he is the most hight the most great

rows.title: Al-Ikhlas
rows.t: al ikhlas say he is allah who is one 1 allah the eternal refuge 2 he neither begets nor is born 3 nor is there to him any equivalent 4

rows.title: Al-Falaq
rows.t: al falaq say i seek refuge in the lord of daybreak 1 from the evil of that which he created 2 and from the evil of darkness when it settles 3 and from the evil of the blowers in knots 4 and from the evil of an envier when he envies 5

rows.title: An-Nas
rows.t: an nas say i seek refuge in the lord of mankind 1 the king of mankind 2 the god of mankind 3 from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws 4 who whispers in the breasts of mankind 5 of the jinn and mankind 6

rows.title: Upon Entering The Morning by Asking for Protection from Allah
rows.t: upon entering the morning by asking for protection from allah we have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to allah and all praise is for allah there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs the dominion and to him is praise and he is over all things competent my lord i ask you for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and i seek refuge in you from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it my lord i seek refuge in you from laziness and the evil of old age my lord i seek refuge in you from the punishment of the fire and the punishment of the grave

rows.title: Upon Entering The Morning with The Grace of Allah
rows.t: upon entering the morning with the grace of allah o allah with your grace and help we enter the morning and with your grace and help we enter the evening by your grace and will we live and by your grace and will we die and to you is the resurrection for all creatures

rows.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
rows.t: sayyid al istighfar o allah you are my lord there is no deity worthy of worship except you you created me and i am your servant i will be true to my covenant and promise to you as much as i can i seek refuge in you from the evil of what i have done i acknowledge your favor upon me and i acknowledge my sin therefore forgive me indeed there is no one who can forgive sins except you

rows.title: Dua for Protection and Good Health
rows.t: dua for protection and good health o allah protect my body from illness and from what i do not want o allah protect my hearing from illness and disobedience or from what i do not want o allah protect my sight there is no deity worthy of worship except you o allah indeed i seek refuge in you from disbelief and poverty i seek refuge in you from the punishment of the grave there is no deity worthy of worship except you

rows.title: Dua for Salvation in The World and Hereafter
rows.t: dua for salvation in the world and hereafter o allah indeed i ask you for well being and safety in this world and the hereafter o allah indeed i ask you for well being and safety in my religion my world my family and my wealth o allah cover my flaws faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see and calm me from fear o allah protect me from the front behind right left and above me i seek refuge in your greatness so that i am not snatched from below me by snakes or swallowed by the earth etc which would cause me to fall

rows.title: Dua for Protection from Shaytan Whispers
rows.t: dua for protection from shaytan whispers o allah knower of the unseen and the seen creator of the heavens and the earth lord of all things and their sovereign i bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except you i seek refuge in you from the evil of myself satan and his soldiers temptations to commit shirk against allah and i seek refuge in you from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a muslim

rows.title: Asking for Protection from All Harms
rows.t: asking for protection from all harms in the name of allah with whose name nothing can harm on earth or in heaven and he is the all hearing all knowing

rows.title: Declaration of Pleasure with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam
rows.t: declaration of pleasure with allah islam and the prophet muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam i am pleased with allah as my lord islam as my religion and muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam as my prophet sent by allah

rows.title: Asking Allah for Guidance
rows.t: asking allah for guidance o ever living o self sustaining by your mercy i seek help rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye

rows.title: Entering The Morning Upon The Natural Religion of Islam
rows.t: entering the morning upon the natural religion of islam in the morning we are upon the fitrah of islam the word of sincerity the testimony of faith the religion of our prophet muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam and the religion of our father abraham who stood upon the straight path a muslim and was not among the polytheists

rows.title: Tawheed Dhikr
rows.t: tawheed dhikr there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs the dominion and all praise and he is over all things competent

rows.title: Read Tasbih
rows.t: read tasbih glory to allah i praise him as many as the number of his creatures glory to allah according to his pleasure as pure as the weight of his throne and as pure as the ink which writes his words

rows.title: Dua for Useful Knowledge, Good Sustenance, and Accepted Deeds
rows.t: dua for useful knowledge good sustenance and accepted deeds o allah i really ask you for knowledge that is beneficial sustenance that is lawful and deeds that are accepted

rows.title: Daily Tasbih and Tahmid
rows.t: daily tasbih and tahmid glory be to allah i praise him

rows.title: Istighfar 100x a Day
rows.t: istighfar 100x a day i seek forgiveness from allah and repent to him

rows.title: Ayat al-Kursi
rows.t: ayat al kursi allah there is no deity except him the ever living the sustainer of all existence neither drowsiness overtakes him nor sleep to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth who is it that can intercede with him except by his permission he knows what is presently before them and what will be after them and they encompass not a thing of his knowledge except for what he wills his kursi extends over the heavens and the earth and their preservation tires him not and he is the most high the most great whoever recites this verse in the morning will be protected until the evening and whoever recites it in the evening will be protected until the morning

rows.title: Al-Ikhlas
rows.t: al ikhlas say he is allah who is one 1 allah the eternal refuge 2 he neither begets nor is born 3 nor is there to him any equivalent 4 the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said recite qul huwallahu ahad and al muawwidhatayn al falaq and an nas in the evening and morning three times and it will suffice you protect you from everything

rows.title: Al-Falaq
rows.t: al falaq say i seek refuge in the lord of daybreak 1 from the evil of that which he created 2 and from the evil of darkness when it settles 3 and from the evil of the blowers in knots 4 and from the evil of an envier when he envies 5 the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said recite qul huwallahu ahad and al muawwidhatayn al falaq and an nas in the evening and morning three times and it will suffice you protect you from everything

rows.title: An-Nas
rows.t: an nas say i seek refuge in the lord of mankind 1 the king of mankind 2 the god of mankind 3 from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws 4 who whispers in the breasts of mankind 5 of the jinn and mankind 6 the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said recite qul huwallahu ahad and al muawwidhatayn al falaq and an nas in the evening and morning three times and it will suffice you protect you from everything

rows.title: Entering the Evening in the Kingdom of Allah and Seeking His Protection
rows.t: entering the evening in the kingdom of allah and seeking his protection we have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to allah and all praise is for allah there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs the dominion and to him is praise and he is over all things competent my lord i ask you for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and i seek refuge in you from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it my lord i seek refuge in you from laziness and the evil of old age my lord i seek refuge in you from the punishment of the fire and the punishment of the grave seeking protection from evil is prioritized the principle that shows the importance of this is preventing harm is more important and prioritized than bringing about good

rows.title: Entering the Evening by Seeking Allah's Mercy
rows.t: entering the evening by seeking allahs mercy o allah by your grace and help we have entered the evening and by your grace and help we enter the morning by your grace and help we live and by your will we die and to you is the final return of all creatures everything we do from morning to evening from the beginning of our lives until we die is all under allahs control and to him we return

rows.title: The Master of Seeking Forgiveness
rows.t: the master of seeking forgiveness o allah you are my lord there is no deity worthy of worship except you you created me and i am your servant i will be true to my covenant and promise to you as much as i can i seek refuge in you from the evil of what i have done i acknowledge your favor upon me and i acknowledge my sin therefore forgive me indeed there is no one who can forgive sins except you whoever recites it with certainty in the evening and then he dies he will enter paradise and likewise if recited in the morning

rows.title: Prayer for Health and Protection
rows.t: prayer for health and protection o allah protect my body from illness and from what i do not want o allah protect my hearing from illness and disobedience or from what i do not want o allah protect my sight there is no deity worthy of worship except you o allah indeed i seek refuge in you from disbelief and poverty i seek refuge in you from the punishment of the grave there is no deity worthy of worship except you by asking allah to grant us well being in our bodies we ask to be healed from all physical and spiritual illnesses so that we have a healthy body and a pure heart and therefore use this healthy body in a way that pleases allah

rows.title: Prayer for Safety in This World and the Hereafter
rows.t: prayer for safety in this world and the hereafter o allah indeed i ask you for well being and safety in this world and the hereafter o allah indeed i ask you for well being and safety in my religion my world my family and my wealth o allah cover my flaws faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see and calm me from fear o allah protect me from the front behind right left and above me i seek refuge in your greatness so that i am not snatched from below me by snakes or swallowed by the earth etc which would cause me to fall the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam never left this supplication in the morning and evening it contains protection and safety for religion the world family and wealth from various kinds of disturbances that come from all directions

rows.title: Prayer for Seeking Protection from the Whispers of Satan
rows.t: prayer for seeking protection from the whispers of satan o allah knower of the unseen and the seen creator of the heavens and the earth lord of all things and their sovereign i bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except you i seek refuge in you from the evil of myself satan and his soldiers temptations to commit shirk against allah and i seek refuge in you from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a muslim the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said to abu bakr as siddiq may allah be pleased with him say it morning and evening and when you want to sleep

rows.title: Remembrance to Be Protected from All Dangers
rows.t: remembrance to be protected from all dangers in the name of allah with whose name nothing in the earth or the heavens can cause harm and he is the all hearing the all knowing whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening nothing will harm him

rows.title: Declaration of Contentment with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam
rows.t: declaration of contentment with allah islam and the prophet muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam i am pleased with allah as my lord islam as my religion and muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam as my prophet whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening allah will grant his pleasure to him on the day of resurrection

rows.title: Asking for Guidance from Allah
rows.t: asking for guidance from allah o ever living o self sustaining by your mercy i seek help rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye the meaning of this supplication is that humans are in dire need of allah and pray that allah does not abandon them even for a moment

rows.title: Entering the Evening on the Natural Disposition of Islam
rows.t: entering the evening on the natural disposition of islam in the evening we are upon the fitrah of islam the word of sincerity the testimony of faith the religion of our prophet muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam and the religion of our father abraham who stood upon the straight path a muslim and was not among the polytheists fitratil islam means upon the sunnah kalimatil ikhlas means the testimony of faith and hanifan means a heart inclined towards the straight path and goodness

rows.title: Remembrance of the Oneness of Allah
rows.t: remembrance of the oneness of allah there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs the dominion and all praise he is over all things competent whoever says this dhikr 100 times a day it is like freeing 10 slaves 100 good deeds are recorded for him 100 mistakes are erased for him he will be protected from the disturbances of satan from morning until evening and no one is better than what he does except someone who practices more than that

rows.title: Reciting Praise to Allah
rows.t: reciting praise to allah glory be to allah as many as his creations glory be to allah as much as his pleasure glory be to allah as much as the weight of his throne and as much as the ink of his written words the prophet sallallahu alayhi wa sallam told juwairiyah that the dhikr above has surpassed the dhikr recited by juwairiyah from after fajr until dhuha time

rows.title: Daily Praise (Tasbih and Alhamdulillah)
rows.t: daily praise tasbih and alhamdulillah glory be to allah and praise be to him whoever says subhanallah wa bihamdihi 100 times in the morning and evening then nothing will come on the day of judgment better than what he has done except one who says the same or more than that

rows.title: Seeking Forgiveness 100 Times a Day
rows.t: seeking forgiveness 100 times a day i seek forgiveness from allah and repent to him ibn umar said the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said o people repent to allah for indeed i repent to him one hundred times a day

rows.title: Prayer for Protection from the Evil of Allah's Creation
rows.t: prayer for protection from the evil of allahs creation i seek refuge in the perfect words of allah from the evil of what he has created whoever recites it three times in the evening they will not be afflicted with fever that night

rows.title: Istighfar
rows.t: istighfar i seek forgiveness from allah when the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam finished his prayer he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above al auzai stated that the recitation of istighfar is astaghfirullah astaghfirullah

rows.title: Allah, The Giver of Peace
rows.t: allah the giver of peace o allah you are peace and from you is peace blessed are you o possessor of majesty and honor when the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam finished his prayer he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above al auzai stated that the recitation of istighfar is astaghfirullah astaghfirullah

rows.title: Allah, The Preventer and The Giver of All Things
rows.t: allah the preventer and the giver of all things there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs dominion and praise and he is over all things competent o allah there is no preventer of what you give and no giver of what you withhold and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment only from you is wealth and honor

rows.title: Allah, The Possessor of All and The Only One Worthy of Worship
rows.t: allah the possessor of all and the only one worthy of worship there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs dominion and praise and he is over all things competent there is no power and no strength except by allah there is no deity worthy of worship except allah and we do not worship except him to him belongs all favor grace and good praise there is no deity worthy of worship except allah making our religion sincerely for him even if the disbelievers dislike it abdullah bin zubair said the prophet sallallahu alayhi wa sallam used to recite the tahlil laa ilaha illallah at the end of the prayer

rows.title: Tasbih
rows.t: tasbih glory be to allah

rows.title: Tahmid
rows.t: tahmid all praise is for allah

rows.title: Takbir
rows.t: takbir allah is the greatest

rows.title: There is No Partner for Allah, and To Him Belongs All Things
rows.t: there is no partner for allah and to him belongs all things there is no deity worthy of worship except allah alone he has no partner to him belongs dominion and praise and he is over all things competent whoever recites the dhikr above his sins will be forgiven even if they are as numerous as the foam on the ocean imam nawawi may allah have mercy on him said that the text of the hadith indicates that subhanallah alhamdulillah and allahu akbar are each recited 33 times separately

rows.title: Ayat al-Kursi
rows.t: ayat al kursi allah there is no deity except him the ever living the sustainer of all existence neither drowsiness overtakes him nor sleep to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth who is it that can intercede with him except by his permission he knows what is presently before them and what will be after them and they encompass not a thing of his knowledge except for what he wills his kursi extends over the heavens and the earth and their preservation tires him not and he is the most high the most great whoever recites ayat al kursi after finishing the prayer nothing will prevent him from entering paradise except death

rows.title: Al-Ikhlas
rows.t: al ikhlas say he is allah who is one 1 allah the eternal refuge 2 he neither begets nor is born 3 nor is there to him any equivalent 4 the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said recite qul huwallahu ahad and al muawwidhatayn al falaq and an nas in the evening and morning three times and it will suffice you protect you from everything

rows.title: Al-Falaq
rows.t: al falaq say i seek refuge in the lord of daybreak 1 from the evil of that which he created 2 and from the evil of darkness when it settles 3 and from the evil of the blowers in knots 4 and from the evil of an envier when he envies 5 the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said recite qul huwallahu ahad and al muawwidhatayn al falaq and an nas in the evening and morning three times and it will suffice you protect you from everything

rows.title: An-Nas
rows.t: an nas say i seek refuge in the lord of mankind 1 the king of mankind 2 the god of mankind 3 from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws 4 who whispers in the breasts of mankind 5 of the jinn and mankind 6 the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said recite qul huwallahu ahad and al muawwidhatayn al falaq and an nas in the evening and morning three times and it will suffice you protect you from everything

rows.title: Supplication for Beneficial Knowledge, Good Provision, and Accepted Deeds
rows.t: supplication for beneficial knowledge good provision and accepted deeds o allah i ask you for beneficial knowledge good provision and accepted deeds beneficial knowledge is a provision that makes life easier obtaining good provision is a persons goal in working and accepted deeds are the hope of every person who performs good deeds therefore a servant should always ask for these 3 things every morning before starting their various activities

rows.title: Supplication Before Sleeping
rows.t: supplication before sleeping in your name o allah i die and i live the prophet sallallahu alayhi wa sallam always started and ended his day with dhikr

rows.title: Supplication Upon Waking Up
rows.t: supplication upon waking up all praise is for allah who gives us life after he has caused us to die and to him is the resurrection by reciting the supplication above a servant begins his day by praising the name of allah the giver of life and the bringer of death

rows.title: Supplication Entering the Bathroom
rows.t: supplication entering the bathroom o allah i seek refuge in you from the evil and the wicked this supplication acts as a barrier between a servants private parts and the jinn when entering the bathroom

rows.title: Supplication Leaving the Bathroom
rows.t: supplication leaving the bathroom i ask for your forgiveness o allah the bathroom is one of the homes of the jinn and devils so it is recommended to ask for forgiveness for any mistakes intentional or unintentional made while in the bathroom

rows.title: Supplication Before Eating
rows.t: supplication before eating in the name of allah the benefit of reciting bismillah before eating is to prevent satan from joining humans in eating

rows.title: Supplication If Forgetting Bismillah at the Beginning of a Meal
rows.t: supplication if forgetting bismillah at the beginning of a meal in the name of allah at its beginning and its end islam pays great attention to etiquette if someone forgets to recite the supplication before eating at the beginning it is still recommended to recite it in the middle even if there is only a spoonful of rice left

rows.title: Supplication After Eating
rows.t: supplication after eating all praise is to allah who has fed me this and provided for me without any power or strength from me the messenger of allah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam said that if someone recites this supplication then his past sins will be forgiven

rows.title: Supplication Entering the Mosque
rows.t: supplication entering the mosque o allah open the doors of your mercy for me the mosque is the house of allah a servant should honor it and hope for allahs mercy within it

rows.title: Supplication Leaving the Mosque
rows.t: supplication leaving the mosque o allah i ask you for your bounty allahs earth is vast and there are many ways to seek provision a servant should ask for allahs bounty to be facilitated in obtaining the provision that allah has distributed to all his servants

rows.title: Supplication Before Performing Ablution
rows.t: supplication before performing ablution in the name of allah it is prescribed to begin every important matter by saying bismillah whether it be an act of worship or otherwise

rows.title: Supplication After Performing Ablution
rows.t: supplication after performing ablution i bear witness that there is no deity except allah alone with no partner and i bear witness that muhammad is his servant and messenger o allah make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves glory be to you o allah and with your praise i bear witness that there is no deity except you i seek your forgiveness and repent to you whoever recites this supplication eight gates of paradise will be opened for him and he may enter from whichever gate he wishes

rows.title: Supplication for Breaking the Fast
rows.t: supplication for breaking the fast the thirst has gone the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed insha allah it is highly recommended for those who are fasting to increase their supplications before and after breaking the fast because the supplication of a fasting person is one of the three supplications that are not rejected

rows.title: Supplication Entering the House #1
rows.t: supplication entering the house 1 peace be upon you the greeting is a supplication of hope a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering and be enveloped in mercy and blessings

rows.title: Supplication Entering the House #2
rows.t: supplication entering the house 2 peace mercy and blessings of allah be upon you the greeting is a supplication of hope a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering and be enveloped in mercy and blessings

rows.title: Supplication Leaving the House
rows.t: supplication leaving the house in the name of allah i place my trust in allah there is no might nor power except with allah whoever recites this supplication it will be said to him you will be guided sufficed and protected satan will then depart from him another satan will say how can you harm someone who has been guided sufficed and protected

rows.title: Supplication for Protection from Causing or Experiencing Harm Outside the House
rows.t: supplication for protection from causing or experiencing harm outside the house o allah i seek refuge in you lest i should stray or be led astray slip or be tripped wrong or be wronged or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me when a person leaves the house they will encounter all kinds of things both good and bad especially harm caused by themselves therefore it is commanded to seek refuge from oneself and from others

rows.title: Travel Supplication
rows.t: travel supplication allah is the greatest allah is the greatest allah is the greatest glory be to him who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our own efforts surely to our lord we are returning o allah we ask you for righteousness and piety in this journey of ours and for deeds that please you o allah lighten for us the hardship of this journey and quickly bring us to our destination o allah you are our companion on the journey and the guardian of our families o allah i seek refuge in you from the hardship of travel from a bad return and from seeing something unpleasant concerning our wealth family or children this supplication has two parts the first is praise of allah and the submission of the servant the second is a request to allah for ease in travel and in the affairs of what the servant has left at home

rows.title: Supplication of a Resident for Someone Who is Traveling
rows.t: supplication of a resident for someone who is traveling i entrust your religion your trust and the end of your deeds to allah three priorities of a servant that must be maintained everywhere religion trust and deeds because a person will be resurrected according to their deeds

rows.title: Supplication for Piety from a Resident to Someone Who is Traveling
rows.t: supplication for piety from a resident to someone who is traveling may allah provide you with piety forgive your sins and ease goodness for you wherever you are piety is the best provision that a servant must prepare for the hereafter because there is no salvation except through piety

rows.title: Supplication When Wearing New Clothes
rows.t: supplication when wearing new clothes o allah to you is all praise you have clothed me with this i ask you for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made and i seek refuge in you from its evil and the evil for which it was made by reciting this supplication one asks that the clothes they have bought may provide goodness and also be a protection against various evils

rows.title: Supplication When Wearing Clothes
rows.t: supplication when wearing clothes praise be to allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me the virtue of reciting this supplication is that past sins will be forgiven insha allah

rows.title: Supplication When Mounting a Vehicle
rows.t: supplication when mounting a vehicle in the name of allah in the name of allah in the name of allah all praise is to allah glory be to him who has subjected this to us and we could not have done so by ourselves and indeed to our lord we will return glory be to you indeed i have wronged myself so forgive me for none can forgive sins except you by reciting the supplication for mounting a vehicle our journey will always be under the protection of allah in addition we will also receive rewards help and a calmer heart

rows.title: Supplication When it Rains
rows.t: supplication when it rains o allah make it a beneficial rain it is encouraged to pray when it rains so that goodness and blessings increase as well as its benefits

rows.title: Supplication During Heavy Rain
rows.t: supplication during heavy rain o allah let the rain fall around us not on us o allah let it fall on the hills mountains small mountains valleys and places where trees grow the supplication above is recited when the rain gets heavier or there is a concern that the rain will cause harm

rows.title: Supplication After it Rains
rows.t: supplication after it rains we have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of allah by reciting this supplication one believes that rain falls by the will of allah allahs virtue not by the stars so they do not become disbelievers in allah

rows.title: Supplication During Strong Wind
rows.t: supplication during strong wind o allah i ask you for the good of this wind and i seek refuge in you from its evil among the signs of allahs power is a strong wind that can bring blessings and punishment namely good and bad therefore a servant should continue to ask for good and seek refuge from all harm

rows.title: The Best Supplication for Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)
rows.t: the best supplication for seeking forgiveness sayyid al istighfar o allah you are my lord there is no deity worthy of worship except you you created me and i am your servant i abide to your covenant and promise as best i can i seek refuge in you from the evil of what i have done i acknowledge your blessings upon me and i acknowledge my sin so forgive me for none can forgive sins except you whoever recites it with certainty in the evening and then he dies he will enter paradise and likewise if recited in the morning

rows.title: Supplication for Ease in All Matters
rows.t: supplication for ease in all matters o allah there is no ease except in that which you make easy and you make the difficult easy if you wish ease comes only from allah even something difficult can become easy insha allah

rows.title: Supplication When Afflicted by Calamity
rows.t: supplication when afflicted by calamity indeed we belong to allah and indeed to him we will return o allah reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better a servant should recite the supplication above when afflicted by calamity with certainty and hope insha allah with this they will receive a better replacement

rows.title: Supplication When in Debt
rows.t: supplication when in debt o allah suffice me with what is lawful and keep me away from what is unlawful and enrich me with your bounty so i do not depend on anyone besides you lawful provision even if it is little is better than abundant unlawful wealth

rows.title: Supplication for Protection from Laziness, Sadness, and Debt
rows.t: supplication for protection from laziness sadness and debt o allah i seek refuge in you from anxiety and grief and i seek refuge in you from incapacity and laziness and i seek refuge in you from cowardice and miserliness and i seek refuge in you from being overpowered by debt and from being overcome by men abu umamah then narrated after i practiced this supplication allah truly removed my anxiety and gave me the ability to repay my debt

rows.title: Supplication After Sneezing
rows.t: supplication after sneezing all praise is to allah indeed allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship it is encouraged to respond to the praise of allah by someone who praises allah and vice versa

rows.title: Supplication Upon Hearing Someone Sneeze
rows.t: supplication upon hearing someone sneeze may allah have mercy on you indeed allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship it is encouraged to respond to the praise of allah by someone who praises allah and vice versa

rows.title: Response to Someone Who Says 'Yarhamukallah' After You Sneeze
rows.t: response to someone who says yarhamukallah after you sneeze may allah guide you and improve your condition indeed allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship it is encouraged to respond to the praise of allah by someone who praises allah and vice versa

rows.title: Supplication for Good Character
rows.t: supplication for good character o allah just as you have made my external form good make my character good as well a charming appearance is not enough provision for a muslim but it must be accompanied by noble character therefore a muslim should constantly ask for their character to be improved and beautified

rows.title: Prayer for Protection from Satan
rows.t: prayer for protection from satan my lord i seek refuge in you from the whispers of satan and i seek refuge in you my lord from their presence around me

rows.title: Prayer After the Adhan
rows.t: prayer after the adhan o allah lord of this perfect call and the established prayer grant muhammad the wasilah a high status in paradise and the excellence above all creation and raise him to the praiseworthy station that you have promised him

rows.title: Prayer for Forgiveness for Parents
rows.t: prayer for forgiveness for parents our lord forgive me and my parents and all the believers on the day the account is established

rows.title: Dua Seeking Good In This World And In The Hereafter
rows.t: dua seeking good in this world and in the hereafter our lord give us good in this world and give us good in the hereafter and save us from the torment of the hell fire

rows.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #1
rows.t: dua to make heart firm upon deen 1 o changer of the hearts make my heart firm upon your religion

rows.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #2
rows.t: dua to make heart firm upon deen 2 o allah controller of the hearts direct our hearts to your obedience

rows.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #3
rows.t: dua to make heart firm upon deen 3 o our lord do not make our hearts incline to error after you have guided us

rows.title: Dua To Seek Refuge Against The Loss Of Pleasure
rows.t: dua to seek refuge against the loss of pleasure o allah i seek refuge in you from the loss of the pleasures that you have bestowed from changes in the health that you have bestowed from your sudden torment and from all your wrath

rows.title: Dua To Resist Affliction
rows.t: dua to resist affliction o allah i seek refuge in you from severe calamity being overtaken by misery evil destiny and the triumphant mockery of enemies

rows.title: Dua To Be Released From Debt, Anxiety, Weakness, Laziness, Fear, And Pressure from Others
rows.t: dua to be released from debt anxiety weakness laziness fear and pressure from others o allah i seek refuge in you from care and grief i seek refuge in you from incapacity and slackness i seek refuge in you from cowardice and niggardliness and i seek refuge in you from being overcome by debt and being put in subjection by men

rows.title: Dua When Getting Good News
rows.t: dua when getting good news praise be to allah by whose grace goodness is perfected
